description: Multi-step import wizard with a step indicator (via TmStepper), back/next/cancel/complete navigation buttons, and customizable button text. Steps are defined as child TmImportWizardStep components.

parameters.name: ActiveStep
parameters.description: Zero-based index of the active step.

parameters.name: ActiveStepChanged
parameters.description: Fires when the active step changes.

parameters.name: OnCancel
parameters.description: Fires when the wizard is cancelled.

parameters.name: ShowStepIndicator
parameters.description: Whether to show the step indicator. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: Parser
parameters.description: Optional parser hook. When supplied, the wizard renders a built-in upload → column-mapping panel: it parses the chosen file, shows the detected columns, and lets the user map each column to a TargetFields entry. When null the wizard behaves exactly as before.

parameters.name: ParseOptions
parameters.description: Options passed to Parser. Defaults to new ImportParseOptions().

parameters.name: TargetFields
parameters.description: Target fields the host declares as mapping destinations for detected columns.

parameters.name: OnMapped
parameters.description: Fires when the user applies a column mapping, carrying the mapping and mapped rows.

examples.title: Three-step import wizard
examples.code:
Upload your CSV file.

Map file columns to fields.

Review and confirm import.
